tools.name: maps_geocode
tools.description: Geocode a place name or address via Nominatim (OSM). Returns lat/lon and display_name.

query.description: Place name or address to geocode

near.description: Optional {lat, lon} bias (device location or a known point)

tools.name: maps_route
tools.description: Compute a walking or driving route between waypoints via OSRM. Returns distance, duration, and GeoJSON geometry.
